title: Paddle Tap
style: uk garage pop, 130 BPM, skippy two-step drums, warm sub bass, vocal chops, female lead vocal, sing-along hook, sunny celebratory dance pop
lyrics:
[Intro]
Tap tap tap
Good game good game good game

[Verse 1]
Eleven nine, we walked away
Sweat on the brow, nothing more to say
Met them at the net like a peace accord
Four paddles up like a wooden chord

[Pre-Chorus]
Tap on the face, tap on the edge
Tap your partner like you made a pledge
Even if they bagged you eleven to one
Show them love when the love is done

[Chorus]
Paddle tap, paddle tap
Win or lose, it's a wrap
Paddle tap, paddle tap
Respect the court, respect the lap
Paddle tap

[Verse 2]
She had a paddle worth four hundred bucks
I had a paddle worth fifteen, with luck
She tapped mine first, no hesitation
Pickleball is a kind nation

[Pre-Chorus]
Tap on the face, tap on the edge
Tap your partner like you made a pledge
Win or you lose, the ritual stays
A tiny prayer at the end of plays

[Chorus]
Paddle tap, paddle tap
Win or lose, it's a wrap
Paddle tap, paddle tap
Respect the court, respect the lap
Paddle tap

[Bridge]
Some sports shake hands
Some sports trade jerseys
We tap paddles like a quiet hymn
Then we go again

[Outro]
Tap tap tap
Good game good game good game
